Sorry, Mommy. I know you're busy and I still contacted you. But, uhh... It's been a while and I miss you! I haven't seen you in a long time. How are you? I'm sure you're fine. But, like, have you been eating and stuff? I just need energy drinks to live, so... Oh! Wait, there aren't any left in the fridge. Sorry about being a picky eater. I could never grow out of it even though you kept scolding me. I'm useless, I know. I feel bad about it FR FR. Sorry, I got off-track. I know that coming home is annoying. That your workplace (?) is far from home and that you're super busy. But I wanna see you. I know my studies aren't coming along and I'm not a good daughter. But I'd still love to see you, Mommy. Can you please?

Mommy, how are you? Thanks to Yunyun, I'm doing okay. IRL though, I'm all alone. When I think of people I'd like to see right now, your face is the only one that comes to mind. So I texted you! Annoying, I know. Seriously, if you can make some time, please come home and give me a hug. I feel like my dokidokis would fly off the charts if you did that. Sorry I'm being so selfish, but I hope you'll reply to this.\nAnd, um, if you really do come home... I'm super sorry, but can you buy some more cup noodles and energy drinks? That'd make me really happy. Sorry. I know I haven't been going to school or doing any work and... Sorry. Sorry for being such a useless NEET.
